criteria.name: Neural Network Design & Implementation
criteria.guidance: Build an appropriate feed-forward or sequence model for forecasting and document architecture.

criteria.name: Data Preparation & Training
criteria.guidance: Construct chronological sequences, scale on training data only and avoid leakage across the split.

criteria.name: Model Evaluation & Overfitting Analysis
criteria.guidance: Evaluate on future holdout data, compare train/validation behaviour and inspect forecast errors.

criteria.name: ML vs DL Comparison
criteria.guidance: Compare deep learning, best ML and naive baselines on the same forecast horizon.

criteria.name: Forecasting Analysis & Findings
criteria.guidance: Interpret forecast horizon, uncertainty and group-level performance; clearly distinguish forecast from actual sales.
